# haruhimemoe

> haruhimemoe is the GitHub organization behind haruhime.moe, a small set of osu! tools for players, mappers and tournament hosts. It holds the packs.haruhime.moe pack builder, the pools.haruhime.moe pool builder (in beta), the bb.haruhime.moe BBCode editor, the haruhime.moe home page, eight TypeScript packages published on npm under the @haruhimemoe scope, and a Claude Code plugin of osu! skills.

One more tool, sheets, is coming soon. It has no public site yet.

Every @haruhimemoe package is ESM only. On Node they need 22.12 or later.

## Tools

- [packs.haruhime.moe](https://packs.haruhime.moe/): Build osu! mappool packs from beatmap IDs or links, download them as one zip or a torrent, and share them with a pack key or a short link.
- [packs.haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://packs.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The packs pages, guides, public packs index and API, in llms.txt format.
- [packs API](https://packs.haruhime.moe/docs/api.md): Read public packs and manage your own from scripts and bots with a personal API key.
- [packs.haruhime.moe source](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe): The Next.js app behind packs.haruhime.moe.
- [pools.haruhime.moe](https://pools.haruhime.moe/): Build an osu! tournament mappool: sign in with osu!, make a pool, search every osu! map under a mod lens (star rating, AR and OD with the mod), add co-editors, check the pool against the content rules for officially supported tournaments, and download it on packs.haruhime.moe. Past tournament pools from tournament hosts, the community and otdb are there as reference, with where each map was played before. In beta.
- [pools.haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://pools.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The pools pages, past and public built pools, and the most used maps, in llms.txt format.
- [pools.haruhime.moe source](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe): The Next.js app behind pools.haruhime.moe.
- [bb.haruhime.moe](https://bb.haruhime.moe/): An osu! BBCode editor with a live osu!-style preview, lint marks and a character counter against osu!'s 60,000 limit; built-in, personal and public templates with fill-in fields; flags, colors and gradients, a player list from osu! names, a collab (imagemap) maker, and a mappool import from pools.
- [bb.haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://bb.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The bb pages, docs (a page per tag and the guides) and templates, in llms.txt format.
- [bb.haruhime.moe source](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bb.haruhime.moe): The Next.js app behind bb.haruhime.moe.

## Home page

- [haruhime.moe](https://www.haruhime.moe/): haruhime's home page: the osu! tools, thanks, the brand kit, a showcase of @haruhimemoe/ui, contact and a disclaimer.
- [haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://www.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The home page's pages and tools, in llms.txt format.
- [haruhime.moe source](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe): The Next.js app behind haruhime.moe.
- [Contact](https://www.haruhime.moe/contact): Email, the Discord server, GitHub, and how to report a security problem privately.

## Packages

- [@haruhimemoe/osu](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu): osu! API v2 for the haruhime.moe tools: beatmap, beatmapset and user shapes with zod schemas (browser-safe at /shapes), a server client with token caching, a rate-budget hook, beatmaps, beatmapsets, star ratings with mods, users and matches, a browser-safe reader and writer for osu!stable's collection.db (at /collections), display formatting for beatmap stats (at /format), multiplayer matches from mp links with game winners and map wins (at /match), and the osu!lazer tournament client's bracket.json (at /tournament).
- [@haruhimemoe/pool](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pool): osu! tournament mappools as data: slots, mod buckets, custom slots with forced or free mods, zod validation, pure editing helpers, pasted-pool parsing, the pk1/pk2/pk3 pack key codec, a content filter, and the packs.haruhime.moe service contract.
- [Pack key format](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pool/blob/main/docs/pack-key.md): The pk1, pk2 and pk3 pack key spec that @haruhimemoe/pool reads and writes, with the decoder rules.
- [@haruhimemoe/mirror](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror): Downloads osu! beatmapsets (.osz) from whichever public mirror has them: hinai first, then osu.direct, Mino and Sayobot, with failover, per-mirror cooldowns and zip checks. Includes the hinai client (metadata, availability, downloads) and msw test mocks. Browser-first; nothing is hosted or proxied.
- [@haruhimemoe/compliance](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/compliance): Check osu! beatmapsets against the content rules for officially supported osu! tournaments. A port of hburn7/omc-api's rules, no network and no dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/bbcode](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bbcode): Parse, render, lint and count osu! BBCode the way osu! does. Safe HTML, template fields, flags, imagemaps and gradients. No dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/tourney](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/tourney): osu! tournaments as data: zod schemas and pure functions for tournaments, brackets, groups, matches, mp links, pick/ban logs, teams, drafts, registration and scheduling.
- [@haruhimemoe/time](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/time): Timezones, weekly availability, match slot finding, regions and .ics files for tournament and event tools. DST-aware IANA zones through Intl, availability grids stored in UTC, ranked match times with who is free, region locks from country codes. No runtime dependencies; zod 4 as a peer.
- [@haruhimemoe/invites](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/invites): Invites as consent: zod schemas for invites and their terms, a pure state machine (pending, countered, accepted, declined, withdrawn, cancelled, expired), resend cooldowns, blocks, rate limits, reminder gating and inbox grouping. No dependencies besides zod.
- [@haruhimemoe/crowdfund](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/crowdfund): Crowdfunding state as data: zod schemas for goals, tiers, donations and refunds, integer minor-unit money math in any currency, goal progress, stretch tiers, top donors that respect anonymity, dedupe, and webhook helpers for Ko-fi, Stripe, PayPal, GitHub Sponsors and Buy Me a Coffee. Never moves money. No dependencies besides zod.
- [@haruhimemoe/vcs](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/vcs): Revisions, diffs and 3-way merges for JSON documents and text. Line diffs, keyed-list aware JSON diffs, diff3 text merge, structured merge with conflicts, canonical hashing. No dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/ui](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui): React components for the haruhime.moe osu! tools on Next.js: the osu!-web-style palette as a Tailwind theme, buttons, cards, form fields and confirms, filter controls, tables, osu! beatmap display pieces and player cards, a command palette, content section tooling, brand pages and the site header and footer.
- [@haruhimemoe/ui showcase](https://www.haruhime.moe/ui): Every @haruhimemoe/ui component in its states, rendered on haruhime.moe from the published package.
- [@haruhimemoe/brand](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/brand): Brand kit generator for the haruhime.moe osu! tools: palettes from one hue, Nunito wordmarks, monogram icons and README banners as outlined SVG, and the PNG icons and link previews Next.js serves as static files.
- [@haruhimemoe/next-kit](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/next-kit): The Next.js plumbing the haruhime.moe tools share: JSON route helpers, rate limits and budgets in MongoDB, bearer machine auth, zod env parsing, a connect-once MongoDB client with safe index builds, better-auth with osu! sign-in, the signed-in marker and account store for the browser, SEO: metadata, robots.txt, sitemaps, JSON-LD and llms.txt, per-app API keys and the /api/v1 guard, account export/delete fan-out and the identity inbox, and locale negotiation with optional next-intl glue.
- [@haruhimemoe/hinai](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/hinai): Deprecated and archived. Use `@haruhimemoe/mirror/hinai`.

## npm

- [@haruhimemoe/osu on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/osu): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/osu zod` (zod 4 is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/pool on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/pool): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/pool zod` (zod 4 is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/mirror on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/mirror): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/mirror zod` (zod 4 is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/compliance on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/compliance): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/compliance`. No dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/bbcode on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/bbcode): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/bbcode`. No dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/tourney on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/tourney): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/tourney zod` (zod 4 is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/time on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/time): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/time zod` (zod 4 is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/invites on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/invites): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/invites zod` (zod 4 is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/crowdfund on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/crowdfund): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/crowdfund zod` (zod 4 is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/vcs on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/vcs): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/vcs`. No dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/ui on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/ui): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/ui`. Its peers are Next.js 16, React 19, React DOM 19 and Tailwind CSS 4 (4.1 or later).
- [@haruhimemoe/brand on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/brand): Install as a dev dependency with `bun add -d @haruhimemoe/brand`. Ships the `haruhime-brand` CLI.
- [@haruhimemoe/next-kit on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/next-kit): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/next-kit zod`. Other peers (mongodb, better-auth, next, react) are optional, per subpath.

## Claude Code plugin

- [claude-plugin](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin): The `haruhime` Claude Code plugin: skills for the osu! API v2, osu! BBCode and `@haruhimemoe/bbcode`, the content rules and official support for osu! tournaments, mappool data and pack keys, the hinai mirror, packs.haruhime.moe and its API, the pools.haruhime.moe pool builder, haruhime.moe branding, UI components and the Next.js server kit, the app and repo standards every haruhime.moe app follows, and the @haruhimemoe packages. Install with `/plugin marketplace add haruhimemoe/claude-plugin`, then `/plugin install haruhime@haruhimemoe`.

## Community

- [Discord](https://haruhime.moe/discord): The haruhime.moe Discord server, for questions and feedback about the tools.
